title: Adaptador Qt6: receitas independentes em controles Qt Widgets reais
scope_completed: Qt6 Widgets partial recipe covers real QPushButton, checkable QPushButton, QCheckBox, exclusive QRadioButton pair, QLineEdit, QComboBox/native popup, QSpinBox/QDoubleSpinBox, horizontal and vertical QSlider, QScrollArea and QScrollBar; translated controls: check, combo, entry, push, radio, scale_h, scale_v, scroll_h, scroll_v, spin, text, toggle, arrow and progress (16/16 catalog controls).

implementation.palette: KDE color roles resolved into private recipe snapshots; palette source changes are validated and stale snapshots rejected.
implementation.rendering: Qt owns range, page step, thumb, wheel and pointer input. A local QScrollBar subclass overlays only the four fixed-size arrow cells after native painting, preserving arrow art at scroll limits.
implementation.geometry: Scrollbar geometry follows tools/domainos_scrollbar_rules.json. Horizontal and vertical QSlider handles use thumb_cross_px plus relief borders and reserve the full cross-axis minimum so Qt does not clip them.
implementation.other_widgets: Qt6 controls not listed in translated_controls remain unstyled by this partial recipe; unsupported visible controls fail closed.

controls.push: A standalone real QPushButton; KDE-role-derived QSS covers normal, pressed, backdrop and disabled states. It can be previewed alone or beside scrollbars.
controls.scroll_h: Existing real Qt6 QScrollBar horizontal recipe, range/page/wheel/input remain native.
controls.scroll_v: Existing real Qt6 QScrollBar vertical recipe, range/page/wheel/input remain native.
controls.toggle: A real checkable QPushButton; KDE-role-derived QSS keeps selected relief sunk, keeps it visually locked while held, releases to raised on the second click, and defines backdrop/disabled states.
controls.check: A real QCheckBox with QSS-painted indicator assets for unchecked/checked × normal/pressed/backdrop/disabled; all surface and relief colors resolve from selected KDE roles.
controls.radio: An exclusive pair of real QRadioButton widgets; generated indicator assets cover unchecked/checked, pressed, backdrop and disabled; selection is exclusive and surface/relief colors come from KDE roles.
controls.entry: A real QLineEdit keeps native UTF-8 entry, cursor, selection, undo/redo and clipboard shortcuts; KDE-role-derived QSS covers normal, focused, backdrop and disabled states.
controls.combo: A real QComboBox and native QAbstractItemView popup use KDE-role-derived QSS and a generated right-aligned arrow; Qt retains popup, keyboard and pointer selection.
controls.scale_h: One real horizontal QSlider. QSS groove/handle colors follow selected KDE button roles; backdrop uses [domainosBackdrop="true"], synchronized from top-level WindowActivate/WindowDeactivate events because QSS :!active also matches an idle slider. Qt retains range, page step, pointer, keyboard and value semantics.
controls.text: A real QTextEdit uses KDE-role QSS for normal, focused, backdrop and disabled states. Window activation updates domainosBackdrop. Qt retains multiline UTF-8 editing, undo/redo, selection, clipboard and context-menu behavior.
controls.arrow: A real QToolButton paints a recipe-owned 11×11 KDE-role arrow glyph inside a 15×15 total control. Qt6 retains click/focus semantics; generated states cover normal, held-pressed, released, backdrop and disabled.
controls.progress: A real QProgressBar retains Qt range/value/fill/text semantics. Normal/backdrop/disabled surface, chunk and text colors derive from KDE roles; focus uses KDE focus relief; domainosState follows activation and native state events.
controls.list: A real QTreeWidget provides native single-row selection, keyboard/mouse semantics and internal scrollbars; KDE-role QSS covers selected/focused/backdrop/disabled states.
controls.frame: A real QFrame with native Panel/Sunken semantics, shared line width, KDE-role-derived face/text and bevel, and top-level activation tracking for backdrop.

limitations: This remains a partial Qt6 Widgets adapter, not a translator for every Qt6 control.
The arrow-cell painter remains a local overlay; range, page step, thumb, wheel and pointer input remain Qt native.
The Qt6 push-button QSS paints one real QPushButton and is not historical pixel-fidelity proof.
Automated checks do not establish historical visual fidelity or user approval.
No new direct comparison against the live Domain/OS SR10.4 VM was performed in this substep.
Checkbox and radio indicator recipes are technically exercised but lack matching native SR10.4 control measurements and human visual approval.
QLineEdit editing shortcuts were verified in a real Qt widget, and its public preview was recorded; no matching native SR10.4 measurement or human visual approval has been made.
QComboBox/popup behavior and arrow placement are technically tested but have no matching native SR10.4 measurement or human visual approval.
The activation/backdrop mapping is a Qt adaptation and is not evidence of historical SR10.4 focus behavior.
No manual user review or approval is recorded for the new slider preview.
Horizontal and vertical QSlider steps are technically validated; neither has a matching appearance/metric measurement from the SR10.4 guest.
